en: Account registration uses your name, email address and sign-in information to create and protect your account and send confirmation or recovery messages. Security controls record registration attempts and notice versions. During the free public beta you may add your own information and documents at your own risk; some protections, such as virus scanning of uploads, are not switched on yet.

Acknowledging this notice does not grant marketing permission, enable optional AI processing or share records with an agency. Sharing and optional processing require their own choices and applicable permissions. We do not request marketing consent during registration.
Deletion is reversible during a 7-day grace window, then permanent. Your audit trail is preserved and anonymized. An active legal hold blocks deletion until released.
Download a complete, structured snapshot of your account: identity, consents, travellers, Master Profile facts with full history, document metadata, and your audit trail.
Export everything, review your consent history, or delete your account.
Glance: your three rights, each one tap away, and the export downloads.
How much you used each AI feature today. Only the number is kept, never what was read. Everything in VisaStack works without these features.

Independent backup and restore protections are still being completed. Do not use this pilot as the only copy of important records. Keep your own originals until real-data safeguards and their acceptance checks are complete.

Need the actual document files too, not just their metadata? Request a large export - a ZIP containing every current, safe document file alongside the same manifest and CSV tables above. It takes a few minutes to prepare and stays downloadable for 24 hours.

Vercel hosts the application. {fileStorage} stores private files. Cloudflare R2 stores encrypted backup archives when backups are configured. Neon stores application records. Neon Auth handles sign-in. Resend handles application email when configured. Authentication email uses the configured sign-in provider's mail service. These services can process information outside your country. This notice does not claim a particular data location or a completed compliance review.

VisaStack helps organize records and workflows. It does not guarantee a visa, certify a document's authenticity or replace advice from an appropriate professional. A readiness status describes the recorded workflow, not the likelihood of approval.

VisaStack is a free public beta, provided as it is. You may use your own details and documents, at your own risk: some protections, such as virus scanning of uploads, are not switched on yet, and the status page lists what works today. Creating an account does not grant access to an agency workspace.
We are working toward a single, verified file that follows a person across visa routes and countries, and gives agencies a calm, clear way to work with it.
Your documents live in your personal record. Cases use selected versions. Agencies receive only the access you choose, within the permissions the platform provides.
Your life does not change between applications. The paperwork should not have to start from zero each time.
Your profile with saved versions, a private document vault, document checks against official requirements, and sharing with agencies.
